{{Top|canon=Heat dissipation shroud}}
'''Heat dissipation units''' were installed in the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plates of [[sandtrooper armor]] to allow [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtroopers]] to handle the harsh conditions of desert operations.
